requirements.text: Provide real-time transaction notifications including transaction amount, merchant name, and updated balance.
Implement biometric authentication using fingerprint and facial recognition for secure logins and sensitive actions.
Automatically categorize transactions into types such as groceries, dining, transport, and entertainment on a monthly basis.
Provide personalized monthly budgets for each category with alerts when nearing or exceeding budget limits.
Enable in-app lending and credit applications with a user-friendly process for applying for overdraft increases, personal loans, or credit limit changes.
Provide transparent terms and conditions, interest rates, and potential fees upfront for lending and credit applications.
Incorporate instant decision-making capabilities for lending and credit applications, providing decisions within minutes.
Include educational resources within the app to explain responsible borrowing and debt management.
Ensure compliance with PSD2, GDPR, and Central Bank regulations.
Integrate with the existing core banking system without making disruptive changes.
